import.descUpload: Upload a CSV exported from your bank.
import.descMap: Tell us which column is which.
import.uploadHint: The first row must contain column headers. Date, amount, and description columns are required. You'll pick the category to assign to all imported rows in the next step.
import.assignCategoryHelp: All imported rows will use this category.
import.dateFormatHelp: How dates are written in your CSV. Pick the right one to avoid swapping day and month.
import.missingMappingsDescription: Mark which columns hold the date, amount, and description.
import.previewShowingFirst: Showing first 50 of {count} rows. All will be imported.
import.fileEmptyBody: No rows were detected. Please check the file.
import.fileErrorBody: Please upload a valid CSV file.

recurring.title: Recurring transactions
recurring.description: Schedule transactions that repeat automatically — rent, salary, subscriptions.
recurring.emptyDescription: Create a recurring rule to auto-generate transactions like rent, salary, or subscriptions.
recurring.toastPausedBody: No new occurrences will be generated.
recurring.toastResumedBody: Occurrences will be generated from the next due date.
recurring.toastToggleErrorBody: Could not change the rule status.

form.startDateHelp: First occurrence date. Future dates are fine.

create.title: New recurring rule
create.description: Schedule a transaction to be generated automatically.
create.toastSuccessBody: The next occurrence will be generated on its due date.
create.toastErrorBody: Could not create the recurring rule, please try again.

edit.title: Edit recurring rule
edit.description: Update this recurring rule. Already-generated transactions are not changed.
edit.toastSuccessBody: Future occurrences will use the new values.
edit.toastErrorBody: Could not update the recurring rule, please try again.
